notes.title: Playtest Update and What’s Next!
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone,[/h3][h3]1️⃣ We’d like to inform you that the [b]Playtest version[/b] previously available is no longer accessible. Unfortunately, a major bug made the game unplayable, and at this stage, fixing it would not be worth the effort compared to focusing on the core development.[/h3][p][/p][h3]2️⃣ We also want to sincerely thank you for the [b]310 wishlists[/b] our game has already received! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated to work even harder.[/h3][p][/p][h3]3️⃣ Looking ahead: before the end of this year we’ll be announcing the [b]release date of our Demo[/b] 🎉.[/h3][p][/p][h3] We hope to count on your support during this stage, as your feedback will be crucial to improve the game and shape it according to what players truly want.[/h3][h3][b]Thank you all for your patience, trust, and continued support![/b] 💙[/h3]
